name: Netherlands Pavilion
india_angle: The Netherlands Pavilion aims to deepen the India–Netherlands partnership in the semiconductor sector through B2B matchmaking and collaboration opportunities.
summary: The Netherlands Pavilion at Semicon India 2026 represents a consortium of over twenty Dutch organizations covering the entire semiconductor value chain. They focus on advanced equipment, materials, process technologies, chip design, and system integration, aiming to foster innovation and resilient supply chains.
